title: Baobab Event Context Registry
description: Governs the <context> segment of com.baobab-platform.<context>.<aggregate>.<fact>.v<major> (ADR-SHARED-018 SS3.2). Related to, but not identical with, the capability namespace registry.

status.description: RESERVED: registered for a decided future steward; no event type may use it yet. DEPRECATED: kept only for already-published types listed in frozen_types (ADR-SHARED-018 SS8.1).

stewards.description: Engines whose accepted ADRs grant authority over facts in this context. Every registered producer of a type in this context is one of them. Empty while no producer authority has been assigned.

authority.description: Accepted ADRs or decision records that ground the stewardship.

capability_domains.description: Related capability domains in contracts/capability/v1/namespace-registry.yaml. Related, not identical (ADR-SHARED-018 SS3.1).

frozen_types.description: DEPRECATED contexts only: the already-published types the context is kept for. No other type may use the context.
